definitions.explanation: A water outlet installed on a street or inside a building that firefighters connect hoses to in order to fight fires. Formed from {消火|しょうか} (extinguishing fire) and {栓|せん} (plug, valve).

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧そば⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{消火栓|しょうかせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a fire hydrant by the road.

examples.japanese: {消火栓|しょうかせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}めて→止める：00678_tomeru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not park your car in front of a fire hydrant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}→消防隊員：29793_shouboutaiin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ホース→ホース：25876_hoosu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{消火栓|しょうかせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つないで{放水|ほうすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The firefighters connected the hose to the fire hydrant and began spraying water.

notes:
Refers both to the red street hydrants and to the indoor hydrant boxes found in large buildings. Marked with red-and-white signs in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{屋内|おくない}→屋内：18948_okunai⟧{消火栓|しょうかせん}: indoor fire hydrant
- {消火栓|しょうかせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ホース→ホース：25876_hoosu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つなぐ: to connect a hose to the hydrant
- {消火栓|しょうかせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the location of the hydrant
